Fitness Hub reads steps, heart rate, sleep and calories from Health Connect. Your watch data gets there through Gadgetbridge. Everything stays on this phone.

What the app reads, stores and sends.

Fitness Hub is a student project. It is not a medical device and does not give medical advice.

What it reads: steps, distance, calories, heart rate, resting heart rate, sleep, workouts, SpO2 and weight from Health Connect, only for the types you allow. You can change this any time in Health Connect.

Where data is stored: only on this phone, in the app's private database. There is no account and no server. Cloud backup of the database is turned off.

What leaves the phone: nothing in this version. A later version adds an optional AI coach. It is off by default and, when you turn it on, sends only a short, anonymous summary with rounded numbers, which you can preview before each request.

Your control: you can revoke Health Connect access at any time. Uninstalling the app deletes all of its data.
